name: K-Scale Labs
summary: K-Scale Labs built open-source humanoid robots for developers, including K-Bot. It laid off most staff and canceled pre-orders in November 2025, then released its designs under open licenses.
funding: Y Combinator Winter 2024 batch; small pre-seed round. Ran out of funding in November 2025.

sources.title: K-Scale Labs Cancels K-Bot Orders, Open-Sources All IP After Funding Fails
